acceptance_state_machine.crypto_submit_result_2: 0x889C2(...,0x202) uses B6 record +0x2E limit2 for CryptoIf submit/busy retries of the current authentication candidate; B4->C3 preserves that counter across busy retries, while 0x8891E resets it when advancing to a new auth/freshness attempt

freshness_commit.failure_action: no copy; committed B6 freshness is unchanged even when failure-forwarding routes the queued payload
freshness_commit.success_action: copy pending 12-byte B6 slot 0xfebe54ec -> committed slot 0xfebe54d4

freshness_results.0x22: hard freshness failure -> A5; no command7; 0x88A56 calls generic failure handler 0x888A6, whose generated failure-forwarding policy can still route the queued B6 to COM while the grace counter is below 204 or the global D2 override mode is active
freshness_results.0x23: 0x8891E(...,0x201) candidate retry; if below B6 limit1, C3->B4 and auth-candidate counter increments
freshness_results.0x24: call freshness-boundary callback through 0x88908; state remains C3 and command7 still executes

acceptance_state_machine.gate1: 0x88C9C reaches post-CMAC gate only when 0x88A56 returns 0

gate2.mismatch: result!=0: freshness commit callback receives 0x00010002 so pending state does not commit; 0x8891E(...,0x200) uses the one same-PDU retry. If that retry budget is exhausted, 0x8891E enters generic failure state 0x96 and calls 0x888A6; the generated failure-forwarding policy may then route the queued PDU42 during the bounded grace/global-override modes. Outside those modes no failed PDU is routed.
gate2.success: result==0: freshness commit callback receives freshness ID2 with high16 clear, pending slot commits, then PDU42 routes to COM

acceptance_state_machine.new_pdu_transition: 0x88702: D2->C3 and resets auth-candidate + CryptoIf-submit retry counters to zero

authentication_candidate_or_mac_mismatch.interaction: 0x8891E increments this counter and resets the CryptoIf-submit counter before B4 retry

cryptoif_submit_busy.interaction: 0x889C2 increments it on driver result2; 0x8891E clears it when an auth/freshness retry is scheduled
cryptoif_submit_busy.scope: current authentication candidate/verification attempt within the queued PDU

acceptance_state_machine.same_pdu_retry_transition: 0x88702 itself performs B4->C3 without an additional reset; the caller that schedules an authentication retry (0x8891E) has already incremented the auth counter and reset the CryptoIf-submit counter to zero

verification_failure_delivery_policy.authentication_boundary: failure-forwarded payloads are not authenticated successes and do not commit pending freshness. Do not describe this as CMAC acceptance; it is explicit generated delivery despite verification failure.
verification_failure_delivery_policy.cmac_mismatch_path: the first result-nonzero mismatch schedules B4 retry; once the one B6 auth/freshness retry is exhausted, 0x8891E sets generic failure 0x96 and calls 0x888A6, so the same conditional failure-forwarding path applies
verification_failure_delivery_policy.delivery_condition: 0x888A6 routes the queued PDU if global override D2 is active OR (profile+0x09 != 1 AND grace_counter < 204). B6 profile+0x09 is 0, so the bounded counter branch applies to B6.
verification_failure_delivery_policy.freshness_0x22_path: 0x88A56 sets A5 then calls 0x888A6 immediately; command7 is never submitted, but the queued payload can still reach COM under the failure-forwarding condition
verification_failure_delivery_policy.global_override_test: 0x00088512 returns true when the state byte is D2; 0x000884E0 can set E1 or D2, but its OEM mode name is not promoted
verification_failure_delivery_policy.grace_increment: 0x00088308 -> 0x00088288 -> 0x000886DA increments the counter by one while below configured 204; wall-clock period is not recovered here
verification_failure_delivery_policy.grace_reset: 0x000886FC can reset the counter to zero; its callers remain a separate lifecycle-policy question
verification_failure_delivery_policy.steady_state_boundary: once grace_counter >= 204 and global override D2 is inactive, the recovered failure handler does not route B6 verification failures through 0x88856

verified_delivery.length_boundary: The recovered queue/delivery path preserves a PduInfo length and PDU42's COM descriptor is 32 bytes. Static evidence does not prove that B28..B31 are physically stripped before COM RAM; the application-consumer census, not a stripping assumption, is the basis for classifying them as SecOC-only.

application_consumer.downstream: raw delta and capped effective gap are stored at GP+0xA4A/GP+0xA4C; CB4F4 consumes the capped gap in target plausibility/supervision

application_sequence_relation.relationship: signal261 is ordinary authenticated application data inside B0..B27. SecOC freshness is reconstructed from B28[7:4] plus SecOC RAM state. Signal261 is unpacked/consumed only on the post-verification COM/application side and does not select the SecOC freshness candidate.
application_sequence_relation.sender_requirement: Maintain both counters: a SecOC message8/reset/trip state for CMAC/FV4 and the independent application signal261 modulo-64 sequence for steering plausibility.

authenticated_envelope.result_evidence: live 0x88C16 tests result!=0 as mismatch; disabled 0x62430 command7 KAT initializes result=1 and reports pass only when result becomes 0
authenticated_envelope.result_polarity: command7 result byte 0 means verified/match; nonzero means mismatch
authenticated_envelope.submit_path: 0x88A56 -> 0x88986 -> CryptoIf job0 -> driver dispatch -> command7 prepare 0x822D0 -> ICU-S command7 0x83BF4
authenticated_envelope.trailer: B28[3:0] || B29 || B30 || B31 after FV4 removal/top-alignment

cross_variant.boundary: H and F application bytes are identical for every record/config/function used by this proof. This does not transfer low-region calibration values or identify the upstream sender.

evidence_boundary: This closes the H/F EPS receiver-side SecOC verification algorithm for protected 0x0B6, including exact freshness state, candidate/window rules, retry scopes, CMAC input/slot selection, commit timing, generated verification-failure forwarding policy, and application-sequence separation. It does not recover the protected slot-4 secret, Toyota's stock sender implementation/cadence, or the upstream FRC/Brake payload/signing producer. For an exclusive replacement sender, however, the receiver algorithm plus authenticated 0x00F closes a deterministic re-anchor/message8 state machine without discovering the stock B6 counter policy.

epoch_transition.not_newer_rule: older/equal candidate returns 0x23 while reset trial index <=3, otherwise 0x22
epoch_transition.staging: accepted/reconstructed candidate is copied to B6 pending slot 0xfebe54ec before CMAC
epoch_transition.strictly_newer_rule: global_trip > committed_trip OR (global_trip == committed_trip AND candidate_reset > committed_reset)

message_reconstruction_same_epoch.overflow_behavior: If the next congruent value would exceed 0xFF, the candidate message is forced to 0xFF and outer 0x89E9A returns status 0x24. The same 0xFF/status0x24 boundary is also reached when the selected reset is already 0xFFFFF.

reset_candidate_search.important_ambiguity: Only current-2 and current+2 collide in the two-bit transmitted reset domain; attempt0 chooses -2 (trial3) and the one allowed same-PDU retry can choose +2 (trial4).
reset_candidate_search.selection: authentication_candidate_retry_counter selects the Nth matching trial

special_status_0x24.meaning: message-0xFF or reset-0xFFFFF boundary candidate notification
special_status_0x24.reason: 0x88A56 calls 0x88908 then reaches the common C3 path that builds/submits command 7; unlike 0x23 it does not transition C3->B4.

trip_wrap.post_verified_sync_action: 0x8A130 commits pending global trip/reset; on wrap it calls 0x8A0AE(0), which clears current+pending ordinary freshness slots whose internal record+0x04 linkage field equals 0, including D7 and B6
trip_wrap.wrap_acceptance: when current trip >= 0xFFFF-15, a nonzero new trip <=16 is treated as forward wrap by 0x89F6E

identifiers.boundary: The authenticated prefix is the 16-bit DataID 0x00B6. Freshness ID2 selects receiver state but is not separately concatenated into the 36-byte CMAC input. No additional source/profile identifier was recovered in that input.

initialization.freshness: 0x00089812 zeros current/pending global sync state and both 12-byte ordinary current/pending slots
initialization.persistence_boundary: This proves application initialization writes these RAM cells; it does not by itself claim a whole-program negative for every possible external/NvM restoration path.
initialization.verify_engine: 0x0008857C clears both retry counters and initializes all three queue states to E1

sender_recipe.cryptographic_blocker: The exact receiver selector is closed, but the slot-4 secret value remains opaque to mapped CPU/application code. A sender still needs that secret or an approved/available ICU-S operation that can produce the required tag.
receiver_required_steps: Track only authenticated/committed 0x00F trip16/reset20 as the global epoch source; do not re-anchor on an unauthenticated sync candidate.
Maintain B6 message8 locally and independently of D7 or signal261.
Encode FV4 in B28[7:4] as message_low2||reset_low2.
Compute AES-CMAC-128 over 00 B6 || B0..B27 || freshness48 using the key selected by protected ICU-S slot4.
Independently maintain application signal261 in B7[5:0] for steering sequence/plausibility semantics.

replacement_sender_state_machine.application_sequence261: Maintain signal261 separately modulo 64. A conservative openpilot policy can require exactly +1 per active transmitted frame even though the EPS itself tolerates a wider effective-gap rule.
replacement_sender_state_machine.message_saturation: If an epoch ever reaches committed message8=0xFF, do not wrap sender CMAC computation to 0x00: the receiver clamps the next congruent candidate to 0xFF/status0x24. Normal observed reset epochs are far shorter than 255 B6 transmissions at expected steering cadences.
replacement_sender_state_machine.new_epoch: When authenticated trip/reset advances beyond the B6 committed epoch, choose the first B6 message8 low2 explicitly (0 is the conservative implementation choice); the receiver's new-epoch branch seeds full message8 directly from the received low2.
replacement_sender_state_machine.power_cycle_persistence: No sender-side message8 persistence is required across full vehicle/sender power cycles when startup always waits for a newer authenticated 0x00F epoch before B6 transmission.
replacement_sender_state_machine.reanchor_delay_boundary: The replacement state machine needs the next authenticated 0x00F epoch after local message8 loss. The wall-clock wait is deliberately not encoded here; observed 0x00F cadence is maintained in the separate freshness-bridge artifact so this receiver builder remains acyclic.
replacement_sender_state_machine.reset_transition_overlap: At a reset advance, an immediately preceding old-reset frame remains reconstructible through current-1 because its reset_low2 uniquely selects that trial; switching immediately to the new reset also works. A replacement implementation should choose one deterministic transition policy rather than race both.
replacement_sender_state_machine.same_epoch: For every subsequently accepted/transmitted B6 in the same trip/reset epoch, advance local message8 monotonically. Normal +1 is simplest; the receiver reconstructs the next congruent forward candidate and accepts deltas +1..+4.
replacement_sender_state_machine.sender_restart_mid_epoch: If the sender process loses its local message8 while the receiver remains in the same authenticated reset epoch, do not guess/replay. Wait for the next authenticated reset/trip advance and re-anchor through the new-epoch rule.
replacement_sender_state_machine.startup: After sender start, observe a strictly newer authenticated 0x00F trip/reset epoch before transmitting B6. This provides a clean receiver re-anchor instead of guessing a pre-existing B6 message8.
replacement_sender_state_machine.trip_wrap: Authenticated 0x00F trip wrap invokes the receiver's ordinary-slot clear; reinitialize the replacement B6 epoch from the committed wrapped sync state.

sender_recipe.runtime_state_blocker: Toyota's stock B6 sender ownership/cadence/initial-message policy remains outside this EPS image, but it is no longer required to construct receiver-valid freshness for an exclusive replacement sender. Physical stock-source suppression and a signing primitive/key remain deployment blockers.

sienna_prior_art.boundary: Sienna supplies role anchors for the generic acceptance engine. The H functions occupy the same control roles near a +0x5A64 Sienna relocation but are not claimed byte-identical: raw differences include relocated calls, GP/table displacements, and generated-profile geometry. H freshness/window conclusions below must be recovered from the target-native H bodies rather than transferred from Sienna.

static_conclusion.short_form: FV4 reconstructs against authenticated 00F state; candidate is staged and command7 verifies CMAC28 with slot4. Only result0 commits freshness, but generated failure-forwarding can still deliver an uncommitted queued B6 during the bounded grace/global-override modes; post-grace normal mode routes only verified success.
